"""Final validation that the implementation meets all requirements."""

import sys
import os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '.'))

from unittest.mock import Mock
from lando.k8s.jobmanager import JobManager, Paths


def validate_requirements():
    """Validate that all requirements are met."""
    print("=== Final Validation of Usage Report Implementation ===\n")
    
    # Test 1: Calrissian command gets usage report flag
    print("1. Testing that calrissian commands get --usage-report flag...")
    mock_job = Mock(username='test', workflow=Mock(url='test.cwl', job_order={}), 
                   volume_size=1, job_flavor_cpus=1, job_flavor_memory='1G')
    mock_job.id = '999'
    mock_job.vm_settings = None
    mock_job.k8s_settings.stage_data = Mock(base_command=["stage"], image_name="img", cpus=1, memory="1G")
    mock_job.k8s_settings.run_workflow = Mock(base_command=["calrissian"], image_name="img", cpus=1, memory="1G")
    mock_job.k8s_settings.organize_output = Mock(base_command=["org"], image_name="img", cpus=1, memory="1G")
    mock_job.k8s_settings.save_output = Mock(base_command=["save"], image_name="img", cpus=1, memory="1G")
    mock_job.k8s_settings.record_output_project = Mock(image_name="img", cpus=1, memory="1G")
    
    manager = JobManager(Mock(), Mock(storage_class_name="test"), mock_job)
    manager.create_run_workflow_job = Mock()  # Don't actually create job
    
    # Actually call it to see the command construction
    manager.cluster_api = Mock()
    manager.create_run_workflow_job()
    
    args, _ = manager.cluster_api.create_job.call_args
    _, batch_spec = args
    command = batch_spec.container.command[2]
    
    success1 = "--usage-report" in command and f"{Paths.OUTPUT_RESULTS_DIR}/report.json" in command
    print(f"   Result: {'✓ PASS' if success1 else '✗ FAIL'}")
    print(f"   Command: {command}\n")
    
    # Test 2: Non-calrissian commands don't get the flag (backward compatibility)
    print("2. Testing that non-calrissian commands do NOT get --usage-report flag...")
    mock_job2 = Mock(username='test', workflow=Mock(url='test.cwl', job_order={}), 
                    volume_size=1, job_flavor_cpus=1, job_flavor_memory='1G')
    mock_job2.id = '888'
    mock_job2.vm_settings = None
    mock_job2.k8s_settings.stage_data = Mock(base_command=["stage"], image_name="img", cpus=1, memory="1G")
    mock_job2.k8s_settings.run_workflow = Mock(base_command=["cwltool"], image_name="img", cpus=1, memory="1G")
    mock_job2.k8s_settings.organize_output = Mock(base_command=["org"], image_name="img", cpus=1, memory="1G")
    mock_job2.k8s_settings.save_output = Mock(base_command=["save"], image_name="img", cpus=1, memory="1G")
    mock_job2.k8s_settings.record_output_project = Mock(image_name="img", cpus=1, memory="1G")
    
    manager2 = JobManager(Mock(), Mock(storage_class_name="test"), mock_job2)
    manager2.cluster_api = Mock()
    manager2.create_run_workflow_job()
    
    args2, _ = manager2.cluster_api.create_job.call_args
    _, batch_spec2 = args2
    command2 = batch_spec2.container.command[2]
    
    success2 = "--usage-report" not in command2
    print(f"   Result: {'✓ PASS' if success2 else '✗ FAIL'}")
    print(f"   Command: {command2}\n")
    
    # Test 3: Report is saved in correct directory for DukeDS upload
    print("3. Testing that report is saved in output directory for DukeDS upload...")
    expected_path = f"{Paths.OUTPUT_RESULTS_DIR}/report.json"
    success3 = expected_path in command
    print(f"   Result: {'✓ PASS' if success3 else '✗ FAIL'}")
    print(f"   Expected path: {expected_path}")
    print(f"   Path in command: {expected_path in command}\n")
    
    # Summary
    all_passed = success1 and success2 and success3
    print("=== SUMMARY ===")
    print(f"Requirement 1 - Add --usage-report flag to calrissian: {'✓ PASS' if success1 else '✗ FAIL'}")
    print(f"Requirement 2 - Backward compatibility (no flag for others): {'✓ PASS' if success2 else '✗ FAIL'}")
    print(f"Requirement 3 - Save in output directory for DukeDS: {'✓ PASS' if success3 else '✗ FAIL'}")
    print(f"\nOverall: {'✓ ALL REQUIREMENTS MET' if all_passed else '✗ SOME REQUIREMENTS FAILED'}")
    
    return all_passed


if __name__ == "__main__":
    success = validate_requirements()
    sys.exit(0 if success else 1)
